payload.reason: The evidence describes the novel aspects of the document-level encoder introduced in the paper, specifically its ability to encode documents and obtain sentence representations, as well as its integration with both extractive and abstractive summarization models.

claims.text: The novel document-level encoder based on BERT can express the semantics of a document and obtain representations for its sentences.
The encoder is used in both extractive and abstractive summarization frameworks, enhancing the model's performance across different summarization tasks.
A new fine-tuning schedule is introduced that uses different optimizers for the encoder and decoder to address their training differences.
